results.description: Skittering Menace: The Hydrohugger has chosen its host and they know it is coming for them! It skitters forward flashing bright lights and colors, single-minded and horrifyingly spider-like. The victim suffers +1 Stress Level and must make an immediate Panic Roll.
Tail Lash: The little monster comes for its target, lashing out with its wicked tail. It attacks with [[5db]] Base Dice, Damage 1. Aside from any damage the victim get +1 Stress Level.

Face Grapple: The Hydrohugger leaps at its victim. Make an opposed roll with [[6db]] Base Dice against the target's Close Combat skill (not counting as an action for the victim):

If the victim wins they throw the beast away, but it's not finished with them yet and attacks the same target again on its next initiative.

If the Hydrohugger wins, the target will suffer the Final Embrace on the Hydrohugger's next Initiative.

The Final Embrace: The Hydrohugger gets to its victim, its acid making short work of any helmet or respirator in the way. Roll for the attack with [[6db]] Base Dice. If it gets one or more Success's, the poor victim is facehugged and immediately Broken. Their last sensations are horrible, yet strangely loving: a firm but gentle caress around their head; a smothering sensation followed by a warm burst of oxygen-rich air filling their lungs; a deep sensation of slow-motion falling; it's okay to fall asleep...
